title: Unanimity of recursive majority
statement: For every positive integer $n$ and every depth $d \in \mathbb{N}$, the recursive majority function on inputs of length $n^d$ outputs $1$ when every input coordinate is $1$, and outputs $-1$ when every input coordinate is $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: the conclusion holds for every natural-number depth $d$
